llm.summary: This is a transparent local note-taking skill that only instructs the agent to store confirmed learning records under a project `.learnings/` folder.

dimensions.detail: The stated self-improvement purpose matches the capabilities: capture lessons, errors, best practices, reviews, and improvement suggestions in local markdown files.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Some trigger phrases are broad conversational phrases, but the artifacts repeatedly require showing proposed write content to the user first and waiting for explicit confirmation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown documentation and a license only; no executable scripts, hooks, binaries, environment variables, or install-time commands beyond normal skill installation are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Requested environment access is proportionate: no declared bins or env vars, no network/upload behavior, no cross-session access, and reads/writes are scoped to `.learnings/`.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Persistence is disclosed, local, and limited to `.learnings/`; destructive clearing is explicitly described as requiring a second confirmation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Installers should understand that this skill can create and read project-local `.learnings/` notes based on conversation context. Use it only if you are comfortable with confirmed lessons or errors being saved locally, and review proposed entries carefully before approving them.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger concern is valid as a usability/scoping note, especially for phrases like “记下来” and “怎么改进,” but artifact evidence shows local-only behavior and confirmation before state-changing writes, so it does not justify a Review verdict by itself.
